• Friendly FOETID BLOAT-DRONE/FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER/HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE.
• Friendly CONTAGION ENGINE units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
This detachment has the ENGINES tag and cannot be taken with another ENGINES **detachment**.

ab.name: Hypervirulent Strains
ab.description: Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" to their Contagion Range (to a maximum of 12").

enhancements.d: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

Biologus Putrifier only. Once per battle, after the bearers unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

Death Guard model only. Each time a Plague Legions unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".
PLAGUE MARINES unit only. When this unit’s attacks target a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit, those attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). Attacks that target this unit with a **S** greater than this unit’s **T** have -1 to wound rolls.

Noxious Blightbringer only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.
Terminator model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
CONTAGION ENGINE unit only. When this unit has fought, one model in this unit heals D3 wounds.
Malignant Plaguecaster only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.
PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.
Friendly HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.

DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the **Plague** listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Enemy units within Contagion Range of this unit also have the effect of that **Plague** in addition to your army’s chosen **Plague** until the end of the battle.

DEATH GUARD model only. If the bearer is leading a Poxwalker unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.
Malignant Plaguecaster only. At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon.
DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearers melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Death Guard model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.
Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

Great Unclean One only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.
DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Malignant Plaguecaster only. While the bearer is leading a Poxwalkers unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer’s unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer’s unit are destroyed.

Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Plague Surgeon only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).

Malignant Plaguecaster only. Each time a Plague Legions unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a Battleline unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).
DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of Poxwalkers models in that unit.
DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

Lord of Poxes only. In the Declare Battle Formations step select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

Lord of Virulence only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Death Guard Vehicle units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those VEHICLE units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.t: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.t: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.t: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.t: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Character unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one other friendly Death Guard unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

stratagems.t: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard unit from your army that includes two Character models.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.tg: One Biologus Putrifier unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.tg: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.fx:
When an enemy unit **engaged** with your unit is selected to make a **fall-back move**, roll one D6:

• On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 **mortal wounds**.
• On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 **mortal wounds**.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.tg: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.tg: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.tg: One Terminator unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.tg: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.tg: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.

stratagems.t: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.tg: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:

• Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.tg: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit **engaged** with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has  -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.tg: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.tg: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has +1 **OC** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.
stratagems.tg: That DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: That **action** does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.tg: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.tg: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Death Guard unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.tg: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more Plague Legions units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.tg: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Plague Legions Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.tg: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.tg: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.rs: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.tg: One Plague Legions unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.tg: Your Death Guard WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Vehicle or Death Guard Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.tg: One Death Guard Character unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

frules.d:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with  this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:

• [LETHAL HITS]
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more Death Guard models from your army, it is Afflicted (see below).

CONTAGION RANGE
Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle:

Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

AFFLICTED
During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.Skullsquirm BlightThis horrifying affliction sees the minds and senses of the victim gnawed gradually away from within.
• Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the **benefit of cover** against that attack.
• Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the **Hit roll**.Rattlejoint AgueLimbs shuddering with fever palsy, bones turned brittle as glass, these warriors can barely act to defend themselves.Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.Scabrous SoulrotVictims of this insidious ailment become glassy eyed and morose as their very animus and essence decay.Worsen the Move, Leadership, and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model’s Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).
When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Plague Legions as your Army Faction.
